data_section_full_text:
We end in 1996 because the returns tests require at least one year of future returns data,
and 1997 is the last year available to us. We eliminate firms lacking financial statement
data needed to calculate accruals, e.g., financial institutions. We also impose minimum
size criteria; we require firms to have sales greater than $25 million, total assets greater
than $50 million, and a share price between $1 and $250. This results in a sample of
24,343 firm-year observations with the required financial statement and returns data;
analyst forecast revisions are available for 20,927 of these.
